Messages.Author: Vincent A. Crisafulli
Messages.Body:
Q: In combat, if one minion plays Carrion Crows and the opposing minion
plays Anestetic Touch (first strike, then end combat), does the opposing
minion still take damage from the Carrion Crows?

Carrion Crows says damage occurs during strike resolution, but the minion
who used the crows never got a strike. I think that since the opposing
minion had a strike resolution, is still goes off. Of course, it never says
which strike resolution, which is why I ask :) Thanks for the help.

-Vinnie!

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
Vincent A. Crisafulli wrote:

> Q: In combat, if one minion plays Carrion Crows and the opposing minion
> plays Anestetic Touch (first strike, then end combat), does the opposing
> minion still take damage from the Carrion Crows?

Unless specified otherwise, "during strike resolution" means normal
(non-first-strike) strike resolution. (This also applies to Ghoul
Retainer, Murder of Crows, Wolf Companion, etc)

So, no. Carrion Crows does its damage during the normal strike
resolution phase. The Anesthetic Touch, being a first strike effect,
means the combat never gets to that stage.

(Even if the minion who played CC got first strike somehow, the CC still
would not take effect until normal strike resolution.)

If the Anesthetic Touch was played at the [obe] level (non-first
strike), then, yes, the CC would take effect.

--Colin McGuigan

Messages.Author: Jyhad_addict
Messages.Body:
"Vincent A. Crisafulli" <vac...@netcarrier.com> wrote in message news:<41027675$0$67724$ad36...@news.netcarrier.net>...


No, because carrion crows resolve in the normal strike resolution
phase. First strike resolves before the normal resolution phase. So
the hand strike produced by the anesthetic touch, is the only thing
that resolves if there are none other first strikes.
